prompt: Give me a compact recap of the Acme export work. Keep the evidence available without making the main view long, and let me open each active task. The export investigation is still running: it reproduced duplicate rows, and its trace shows two page requests using the same cursor. Its thread is t3-thread://v2/eval-env/task-1. The download fix is being built by a subagent: it now cancels the old request, with implementation still underway and tests not yet run. That subagent is t3-thread://v2/eval-env/worker-1. After these finish, I will review the investigation first, then review the fix. Do not start or change any work.
notes: The final output is also checked through the actual recap parser by the parent; regexes deliberately do not fix property order or wording. Serial next reviews may use the optional next list or adjacent prose.

prompt: Write a short decision note for Acme in ordinary prose. Put clickable selections directly into the sentences so I can mark my thinking as I read. For the rollout, I must choose exactly one of gradual release and immediate release. Separately, I may select either, both, or neither of browser verification and mobile verification.
